LibreTexts page licence: 'CC BY-NC-SA 2.5'. 17 chapters: crystallography, optics, hardness, SG, equipment, inclusions, treatments, synthetics, gem descriptions, lapidary. The full-book PDF (batch.libretexts.org/.../geo-3164/Full.pdf) came back broken (1 page); use HTML.

eCampusOntario record rights: CC BY 4.0; the book's 'Exceptions to the CC BY Licence' page lists some figures under other licences. A general geology textbook (minerals, crystals and rocks chapters), not about gems. The PDF is 249 MB; an EPUB and XHTML are on the same record.
USGS General Interest Publication (pubs.usgs.gov 7000029/7000030); the PDF is the 1992 printing and the HTML is v1.1 (2001). Short (20 pp): a beginner primer, under 40 pages.

gem.t: Gemstones: An Overview of Production of Specific U.S. Gemstones (Special Publication 14-95)
gem.evidence: Federal Bureau of Mines publication, now hosted by USGS: 'contains the text of the originally published book in its entirety'. 17 HTML pages, about 17,000 words; the page count is estimated from that.

gem.t: Gem Stones of the United States (Bulletin 1042-G)
gem.a: Dorothy M. Schlegel, US Geological Survey
gem.evidence: USGS Bulletin 1042-G, pp. 203-253; USGS publications are public domain.
